title: Astrid and the Autopsy
author: Ansel Villalobos
blurb: Sebastian Ashgrove, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
